name: USB - Authorized - Device IDs [is]
description: Intent: Authorized USB device IDs — populate with vendor/product IDs or serial numbers of every corporate-issued encrypted USB and sanctioned SD device (e.g., 0781:556d for a known SanDisk model, or specific serials of issued IronKeys). Drives the Authorized split on M7000 and is negated in M7010 / W7010 / B7000 to define the unauthorized removable-media surface. Lower priority unless your org runs a USB encryption / inventory program. Exclusions: do not add devices without verifiable hardware IDs; do not list user-owned drives.
